question: Should CodexBar accept forwarding every imported `longcat.chat` cookie to LongCat’s own usage endpoints when the exact Meituan authentication cookie is undocumented?
rationale: The implementation isolates transport and avoids intentional sensitive-body logging, but source and mocked tests cannot decide the repository’s acceptable credential-minimization policy for this built-in provider.

options.title: Narrow cookie allowlist
options.body: Identify the minimum working cookie names, forward only those values, and cover the allowlist before merge.

options.title: Accept full same-domain jar
options.body: Explicitly accept the isolated full-cookie header after redacted live proof confirms behavior and that sensitive values do not appear in logs.

options.title: Defer LongCat support
options.body: Pause the provider until LongCat offers a documented usage API or stable authentication contract.

recommendation.title: Narrow cookie allowlist
recommendation.body: Identify the minimum working cookie names, forward only those values, and cover the allowlist before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and adjacent provider architecture owner, this person is the best available owner for the credential-policy choice.
